In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥20,778 million (down 1.0% from the previous year).
entries.51486e390b0c2da5: Automobile manufacturers in Japan, North America and Europe (the annual securities report states they are main customers; direct sales to vehicle manufacturers are the Tier1 business, and sales to automotive parts manufacturers are the Tier2 business)
entries.63564490afeb71d8: A reportable segment that makes and sells electronic components such as switches, actuators, and haptic reactors. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥358.3 billion (up 3.0% from the previous year) and operating profit was ¥30.1 billion (down 0.8% from the previous year). The securities report gives increases in products for the mobile, consumer, and automotive markets as the reason for the increase in revenue. It explains that operating profit decreased from the previous year because of changes in product mix and rising material prices. Apple Inc., a major customer (revenue of ¥236,625 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026, 23.2% of total sales results), is a party for which the securities report lists this segment as the related segment.
entries.6ac755b05942d266: A reportable segment that makes and sells electronic components such as sensors and communication devices. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥85.2 billion (up 1.3% from the previous year) and operating loss was ¥3.5 billion (the previous year's operating loss was ¥3.3 billion). The securities report states that although products for the automotive market were in a transition period as keyless entry system products of conventional models are being replaced by digital key products, and were affected by the business transfer of power inductor products, small photo printers for the mobile market grew, so the business as a whole recorded higher revenue. It explains that operating results worsened from the previous year because of the decrease in revenue from the business transfer of power inductor products and a rise in the variable cost ratio.

entries.b4de8231eca67278: A reportable segment that makes and sells electronic components such as sensors and communication devices.
entries.bc7079f571a137d3: A reportable segment that makes and sells electronic components such as switches, actuators, and haptic reactors.
entries.d6cb67ef1c51a437: A reportable segment that makes and sells products such as automotive modules, information and communication equipment including infotainment, displays, and sound. It has the largest sales to external customers of the 3 reportable segments. From the fiscal year ended March 2026, its former name "Module and System Business" was changed to "Mobility Business". The securities report states that the name change has no effect on segment information. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥555.0 billion (up 3.3% from the previous year) and operating profit was ¥14.1 billion (up 152.6% from the previous year). The securities report states that after the previous year, when the segment was affected by production cuts at its main customers, the Japanese, North American and European automakers, in the Chinese market, a slight recovery this year and the launch of new products increased revenue. It explains that operating profit increased because of the recovery in sales and sales of new products, as well as the reduction of unprofitable products and the effect of the previous year's capacity utilization variance caused by demand fluctuations. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, an impairment loss of ¥4.2 billion on business assets related to sound products and other assets was also recorded as an extraordinary loss for the consolidated group as a whole.
